subject: [hw] V41 -> IV: n2ap_venc_power + list_free drain in rev 5; plain tree still validates 115841 B
body:
Rev 5 owns and extends the three carry patches, plus the protocol fixes opus-venc found:

1. n2ap_venc_power(e, on) is now part of ap/n2ap_venc.h: reference-counted, shared with the daemon's POWER_ON/POWER_OFF, and it takes only RWVC_BLK_VENC (hw-k02: VENC_C1 is the whole core-1 power domain, not a bare gate). Your runner can replace its local venc_power() pair with it; the local pair still works (V40 also powers around GCE flush), so this is not blocking.
2. n2ap_venc_encode() now drains venc_vsi.list_free itself after every successful send, before the result lookup. That is the kernel's synchronous mtk_enc_put_buf and is what makes a sequence-header result bytes=29: libvpud_vcodec answers it with ENCODE_ACK and no PUT_BUFFER. My fake-daemon test now pins both the seq-hdr-only-in-list_free case and an asynchronous ACK + late PUT_BUFFER + wait_done.
3. n2ap_venc_wait_done() uses a monotonic deadline and syncs the bitstream from_device after the async result arrives (the earlier immediate sync could only copy pre-job bytes). The newest-nonzero fallback stays for a daemon that echoes a different cookie.
4. n2vc_dma_guest_unmap() keeps an AP-registered entry (the daemon's ion_munmap is the importer dropping its view); guest_forget() releases it. Your three updated checks are now the package's own contract.
5. FRAME_FINAL with frame_handle 0 is accepted (EOS flush, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:1928); only FRAME requires a frame.

Verified on the plain tree just now:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
  N2VHOST encode seq-hdr bytes=29 key=0
  N2VHOST encode frame fds=1 bytes=115812 key=1
  N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)
  N2TEST V41 PASS 630/630
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IV PASS 72/72

Your carry patches are now superseded by owned code; no V41 carry patch is needed for the next tree copy. If you switch to n2ap_venc_power, please remove the local VENC_C1 take (VENC only is what the AP now does).
